Lithium ion batteryThe application is a divisional application of an original invention patent application (application date is 28.04.2018, application number is 201810398055.0, and the invention name is 'negative pole piece and battery').

Technical Field

The invention relates to the field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery.

Background

The new energy vehicle replaces the traditional fuel vehicle, the charging speed is one of key technologies which must be overcome, and the charging speed is also an important index which influences the user experience, so that a great amount of manpower and material resources are continuously input into each large power battery enterprise. In a particular power battery system, the key to determining its charge rate is the negative electrode.

At present, most research focuses on the design of a negative active material, and the attention on the design of a negative pole piece is very little. A large number of researches show that the negative active material with excellent power performance can not always achieve the aim of continuous quick charge if adopting an unreasonable pole piece design, and the negative active material with general power performance can achieve the effect of quick charge if adopting a reasonable pole piece design. Therefore, the selection of the negative active material and the design of the negative pole piece are the key points for realizing rapid charging.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the problems in the background art, an object of the present invention is to provide a lithium ion battery that has the advantages of fast charging speed, high energy density, good safety and long cycle life.

In order to achieve the above object, the present invention provides a lithium ion battery, which includes a negative electrode plate, a positive electrode plate, an isolation film and an electrolyte, wherein the positive electrode plate includes a positive electrode current collector and a positive electrode diaphragm disposed on the surface of the positive electrode current collector and including a positive electrode active material, and the negative electrode plate includes a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode diaphragm disposed on at least one surface of the negative electrode current collector and including a negative electrode active material. The positive active material includes lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, and the negative active material includes graphite. The graphite is selected from one or more of natural graphite and artificial graphite.

The negative active material also comprises one or more of soft carbon, hard carbon, carbon fiber, mesocarbon microbeads, silicon-based materials, tin-based materials and lithium titanate.

The positive active material further includes lithium cobalt oxide, lithium nickel oxide, lithium manganese oxide, lithium nickel cobalt aluminum oxide, and lithium-containing phosphate of olivine structure.

Compared with the prior art, the invention at least comprises the following beneficial effects:

the anode active material comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, the cathode active material comprises graphite, and more effective end faces for active ion deintercalation in the cathode pole piece are ensured by matching the relation between the OI value of the cathode membrane and the compaction density of the cathode membrane and the relation between the particle size of the cathode active material and the powder OI value of the cathode active material, so that the rapid deintercalation of the active ions is facilitated, the high safety and the rapid charging requirement of the lithium ion battery are further ensured, and the long cycle life and the high energy density of the lithium ion battery can be ensured under the condition of large-rate rapid charging.

Detailed Description

The negative electrode sheet and the battery according to the present invention are described in detail below.

First, a negative electrode sheet according to a first aspect of the present invention is explained, which includes a negative electrode current collector and a negative electrode membrane disposed on at least one surface of the negative electrode current collector and including a negative electrode active material. The negative active material comprises graphite, and the negative diaphragm has an OI value VOIThe relation between the compacted density PD of the negative electrode membrane sheet satisfies the following conditions: 0.7 is less than or equal to (80/V)OI+43/PD)×PD/VOILess than or equal to 21.5, wherein the unit of the compacted density PD of the negative electrode diaphragm is g/cm3。

Generally, during the charging process of the battery, the following 3 electrochemical processes are required for the negative electrode plate: (1) active ions (such as lithium ions, sodium ions and the like) removed from the positive active material enter the electrolyte, and enter the inside of the pore channel of the negative membrane along with the electrolyte, so that the liquid phase conduction of the active ions in the pore channel is completed, and the liquid phase conduction comprises liquid phase diffusion and electromigration; (2) the active ions and the electrons complete charge exchange on the surface of the cathode active material; (3) the active ions are solid-phase conducted from the surface of the negative electrode active material to the inside of the negative electrode active material crystal.

If the compaction density of the negative electrode diaphragm is too high, the negative electrode active material particles are forced to be arranged in parallel to the current collector, part of the end faces of the negative electrode active material particles for active ion extraction lose effect, the effective end faces of the negative electrode pole piece for active ion extraction are reduced, and the OI value of the negative electrode diaphragm is also too large, so that the dynamic performance of the battery is reduced; if the compaction density of the negative electrode diaphragm is too small, negative active material particles tend to be arranged in a disordered manner, although the effective end face for active ion deintercalation in the negative electrode piece is more, the OI value of the negative electrode diaphragm is also smaller, the electronic conductance of the negative electrode piece is influenced, and the negative electrode piece has risks such as powder falling and crumpling, so that the improvement of the charging speed of the battery is influenced.

Therefore, the compacted density of the negative electrode membrane and the OI value of the negative electrode membrane significantly affect the charge rate of the battery. In the design of the negative pole piece, the OI value V of the negative pole diaphragm is adjustedOIWhen the density of the negative electrode film sheet satisfies 0.7. ltoreq. 80/V in combination with the compacted density PD of the negative electrode film sheetOI+43/PD)×PD/VOIWhen the charging voltage is less than or equal to 21.5, the battery with the characteristics of high charging speed, high energy density, good safety and long cycle life can be obtained.

Preferably, the OI value V of the negative electrode diaphragmOIThe relation between the compacted density PD of the negative electrode diaphragm satisfies the following conditions: 1.8 is less than or equal to (80/V)OI+43/PD)×PD/VOI≤16。

The inventors also found that when the particle size D50 of the negative active material is too large, the number of end faces of the negative active material particles for active ion extraction is too small, and the solid phase diffusion resistance of the active ions in the negative active material particles is large, so that the charging speed of the battery cannot be effectively increased; when the particle size D50 of the negative active material is too small, the negative slurry is difficult to disperse, and the adhesion between the negative active material particles and the negative current collector and the adhesion between the negative active material particles and the particles are poor when the negative pole piece is manufactured, which affects the consistency of the battery. Meanwhile, when the powder OI value of the negative active material is too large, the number of end faces of the negative active material particles for active ion extraction is small, and the charging speed of the battery cannot be effectively increased; when the powder OI value of the negative active material is too small, the negative active material particles tend to be arranged in an isotropic manner, so that the negative pole piece is easily crumpled and shed powder in the circulating process, and the circulating life of the battery is influenced.

The inventors have further studied and found that, when the negative electrode active material is appropriately designed so that the particle diameter D50 (in μm) of the negative electrode active material and the powder OI value G of the negative electrode active material are equal to each otherOISatisfies the condition of 2.8 ≤ 100/(D50+2.8 × GOI) When the charging rate is less than or equal to 12, the charging speed, the energy density, the safety and the cycle life of the battery are further improved.

Preferably, the particle diameter D50 of the negative electrode active material and the powder OI value G of the negative electrode active materialOIThe relation between the two satisfies 4 ≦ 100/(D50+2.8 × G)OI)≤8.5。

In the design process of the battery, the parameters of the negative pole piece are reasonably designed, the influence of the negative active material used by the negative membrane on the performance of the battery is considered, and the performance of the battery can be further improved after the negative active material and the negative active material are comprehensively considered and reasonably matched.

The inventors have further investigated and found that when the negative electrode active material and negative electrode tab design meets 2.8 ≦ (X × 0.8+ Y × 0.2) × Y/X ≦ 15 (where X ═ 80/VOI+43/PD)×PD/VOI，Y＝100/(D50+2.8×GOI) Preferably, the design of the negative active material and the negative pole piece meets 3.5 ≦ (X × 0.8.8 + Y × 0.2.2) × Y/X ≦ 12.5.

In the negative electrode sheet of the first aspect of the invention, the negative electrode film preferably has a compacted density PD of 0.8g/cm3～2.0g/cm3Further preferably, the negative electrode film sheet has a compacted density PD of 1.0g/cm3～1.6g/cm3。

In the negative electrode sheet of the first aspect of the invention, the negative electrode diaphragm has an OI value VOIPreferably 2 to 60, and further preferably, the OI value V of the negative electrode diaphragmOIIs 3 to 32.

In the negative electrode sheet of the first aspect of the invention, the particle diameter D50 of the negative electrode active material is preferably 1 μm to 20 μm; more preferably, the particle diameter D50 of the negative electrode active material is 4 to 15 μm.

In the negative electrode sheet of the first aspect of the invention, the powder OI value G of the negative electrode active materialOIPreferably 0.5 to 7; more preferably, the powder OI value G of the negative electrode active materialOI2 to 4.5.

In the negative electrode sheet of the first aspect of the present invention, the negative electrode membrane may be provided on one of the surfaces of the negative electrode current collector or may be provided on both surfaces of the negative electrode current collector.

In the negative electrode plate of the first aspect of the present invention, the graphite may be one or more selected from artificial graphite and natural graphite.

In the negative electrode plate of the first aspect of the present invention, the negative active material may include one or more of soft carbon, hard carbon, carbon fiber, mesocarbon microbeads, a silicon-based material, a tin-based material, and lithium titanate, in addition to graphite. Wherein, preferably, the silicon-based material can be selected from elementary silicon, silicon-oxygen compound, silicon-carbon compound and silicon alloy, and the tin-based material can be selected from elementary tin, tin-oxygen compound and tin alloy.

In the negative electrode plate of the first aspect of the present invention, the negative electrode diaphragm further includes a conductive agent and a binder, where the types and contents of the conductive agent and the binder are not particularly limited and can be selected according to actual requirements.

In the negative electrode sheet of the first aspect of the present invention, the kind of the negative electrode current collector is not particularly limited, and may be selected according to actual requirements, and preferably, a copper foil is used.

In the negative electrode tab of the first aspect of the invention:

the particle diameter D50 of the negative electrode active material was measured by a particle size distribution laser diffraction method (specifically, GB/T19077-2016) using a laser diffraction particle size distribution measuring instrument (Mastersizer 3000), and the average particle diameter was represented by a median value D50 of the volume distribution.

The powder OI value of the negative electrode active material and the OI value of the negative electrode membrane can be obtained by using an X-ray powder diffractometer (X' pert PRO), and X-ray diffraction analysis can be performed according to the general rule of X-ray diffraction analysis and the method for measuring lattice parameters of graphite JIS K0131-Line diffraction pattern, OI value ═ C004/C110Wherein, C004Peak area of 004 characteristic diffraction peak, C110The peak area of the characteristic diffraction peak is 110.

The compacted density PD of the negative electrode diaphragm is m/V, m represents the weight of the negative electrode diaphragm, V represents the volume of the negative electrode diaphragm, m can be obtained by weighing with an electronic balance with the precision of more than 0.01g, the product of the surface area of the negative electrode diaphragm and the thickness of the negative electrode diaphragm is the volume V of the negative electrode diaphragm, wherein the thickness can be obtained by measuring with a spiral micrometer with the precision of 0.5 mu m.

In the negative electrode tab of the first aspect of the present invention, the process for preparing the negative electrode tab may include the steps of:

(1) stirring: dissolving a negative electrode active material, a conductive agent and a binder in a solvent according to a certain proportion to prepare uniformly dispersed slurry;

(2) coating: uniformly coating the slurry on a current collector, and fully drying the current collector through an oven to remove the solvent;

(3) cold pressing: carrying out cold pressing treatment on the dried negative pole piece under certain pressure and roll gap;

(4) cutting: and cutting the cold-pressed negative pole piece to a specified size for later use.

In the preparation process of the negative pole piece, the particle size D50 of the negative pole active substance and the powder OI value G of the negative pole active substanceOIOI value V of negative electrode diaphragmOIHas certain effect by controlling D50 and GOITo obtain the required VOI(ii) a Or a magnetic field induction technology can be introduced in the slurry coating process to artificially induce the arrangement of the negative active substance on the negative pole piece and change the OI value V of the negative membraneOIThe size of (d); in the cold pressing process, the arrangement of the negative active materials on the negative electrode diaphragm can be changed by adjusting the compaction density, and the OI value V of the negative electrode diaphragm can be further changedOIThe size of (2).

Next, a battery according to a second aspect of the present invention, which includes the negative electrode tab, the positive electrode tab, the separator, the electrolyte, and the like according to the first aspect of the present invention, will be described.

It should be noted that the battery according to the second aspect of the present application may be a lithium ion battery, a sodium ion battery, or any other battery using the negative electrode sheet according to the first aspect of the present invention.

Specifically, when the battery is a lithium ion battery:

the positive pole piece comprises a positive pole current collector and a positive pole membrane which is arranged on the surface of the positive pole current collector and comprises a positive pole active substance, wherein the positive pole active substance can be selected from lithium cobalt oxide, lithium nickel oxide, lithium manganese oxide, lithium nickel cobalt aluminum oxide, lithium containing phosphate with an olivine structure and the like. These positive electrode active materials may be used alone or in combination of two or more. Preferably, the positive active material may be selected from LiCoO2、LiNiO2、LiMnO2、LiMn2O4、LiNi1/3Co1/3Mn1/3O2(NCM333)、LiNi0.5Co0.2Mn0.3O2(NCM523)、LiNi0.6Co0.2Mn0.2O2(NCM622)、LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2(NCM811)、LiNi0.85Co0.15Al0.05O2、LiFePO4、LiMnPO4One or more of them.

Specifically, when the battery is a sodium ion battery:

the positive pole piece comprises a positive current collector and a positive diaphragm which is arranged on the surface of the positive current collector and comprises a positive active substance, wherein the positive active substance can be selected from transition metal oxide NaxMO2(M is a transition metal, preferably one or more selected from Mn, Fe, Ni, Co, V, Cu and Cr, 0<x is less than or equal to 1), polyanionic materials (phosphate, fluorophosphate, pyrophosphate, sulfate), prussian blue materials and the like, but the application is not limited to the materials, and other conventionally known materials which can be used as the positive electrode active material of the sodium ion battery can be used. These positive electrode active materials may be used alone or in combination of two or moreTwo or more of them are used in combination. Preferably, the positive electrode active material may be selected from NaFeO2、NaCoO2、NaCrO2、NaMnO2、NaNiO2、NaNi1/2Ti1/2O2、NaNi1/2Mn1/2O2、Na2/3Fe1/3Mn2/3O2、NaNi1/3Co1/3Mn1/3O2、NaFePO4、NaMnPO4、NaCoPO4Prussian blue material with the general formula AaMb(PO4)cOxY3-xWherein A is selected from H+、Li+、Na+、K+、NH4+M is transition metal cation, preferably one or more selected from V, Ti, Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu and Zn, Y is halogen anion, preferably one or more selected from F, Cl and Br, 0<a≤4，0<b is less than or equal to 2, c is less than or equal to 1 and less than or equal to 3, and x is more than or equal to 0 and less than or equal to 2).

In the battery of the second aspect of the present invention, the specific types and compositions of the separator and the electrolyte are not particularly limited, and may be selected according to actual requirements.

The present application is further illustrated below with reference to examples. It should be understood that these examples are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to limit the scope of the present application.

The batteries of examples 1 to 36 and comparative examples 1 to 4 were each prepared as follows.

(1) Preparation of positive pole piece

Mixing a positive electrode active substance NCM523, a conductive agent acetylene black and a binder PVDF according to a mass ratio of 96:2:2, adding a solvent NMP, and stirring under the action of a vacuum stirrer until the system is uniform to obtain positive electrode slurry; and uniformly coating the positive electrode slurry on a positive electrode current collector aluminum foil, airing at room temperature, transferring to an oven for continuous drying, and then carrying out cold pressing, slitting and cutting to obtain the positive electrode piece.

(2) Preparation of negative pole piece

Mixing negative active material graphite or a mixture of graphite and other active materials according to different mass ratios, conductive agent acetylene black, thickening agent CMC and binder SBR according to the mass ratio of 96.4:1:1.2:1.4, adding solvent deionized water, and stirring under the action of a vacuum stirrer until the system is uniform to obtain negative slurry; and uniformly coating the negative electrode slurry on a copper foil of a negative current collector, airing at room temperature, transferring to an oven, continuously drying, and then performing cold pressing, slitting and cutting to obtain a negative electrode plate.

(3) Preparation of the electrolyte

Mixing Ethylene Carbonate (EC), Ethyl Methyl Carbonate (EMC) and diethyl carbonate (DEC) according to a volume ratio of 1:1:1 to obtain an organic solvent, and then fully drying lithium salt LiPF6Dissolving the mixture in the mixed organic solvent to prepare electrolyte with the concentration of 1 mol/L.

(4) Preparation of the separator

Selected from polyethylene films as barrier films.

(5) Preparation of lithium ion battery

Stacking the positive pole piece, the isolating film and the negative pole piece in sequence to enable the isolating film to be positioned between the positive pole piece and the negative pole piece to play an isolating role, and then winding to obtain a bare cell; and placing the bare cell in an outer packaging shell, drying, injecting electrolyte, and performing vacuum packaging, standing, formation, shaping and other processes to obtain the lithium ion battery.

Next, performance tests of the lithium ion battery are explained.

(1) And (3) testing the dynamic performance: and (3) repeating the lithium ion batteries prepared in the examples and the comparative examples at 25 ℃ for 10 times by fully charging at 4C and fully discharging at 1C, fully charging at 4C, disassembling the negative pole piece and observing the lithium precipitation condition on the surface of the negative pole piece. Wherein, the lithium precipitation area of the surface of the negative electrode of less than 5 percent is considered to be slightly lithium precipitation, the lithium precipitation area of the surface of the negative electrode of 5 percent to 40 percent is considered to be moderately lithium precipitation, and the lithium precipitation area of the surface of the negative electrode of more than 40 percent is considered to be severely lithium precipitation.

(2) And (3) testing the cycle performance: the lithium ion batteries prepared in examples and comparative examples were charged at a rate of 3C and discharged at a rate of 1C at 25C, and full charge discharge cycle tests were performed until the capacity of the lithium ion battery had decayed to 80% of the initial capacity, and the number of cycles was recorded.
